deliverables: WP 1 - Intersect operations and ecosystem coordination: 6,000,000 ADA
WP 2 - Technical Stewardship, Incident Response & Coordination, including core Cardano repos: 18,800,000 ADA
WP 3 - Management of critical processes: 600,000 ADA
Milestone-based drawdowns, evidence-backed reporting, transparent disclosures, and external assurance
request.recipient: Intersect via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stated in the document
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Intersect governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, repository management, security initiatives, and management of critical processes for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect states the proposal funds its core operating model from June 2026 to June 2027, including governance coordination, critical unowned process capacity, technical stewardship, incident response, and release coordination.
Intersect states the overall ask has been reduced from $7.875M last year to $6.35M while preserving functions it considers critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect states it has already coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The budget summary allocates 6,000,000 ADA to operations and ecosystem coordination, 18,800,000 ADA to technical stewardship and incident response, and 600,000 ADA to critical process management, totaling 25,400,000 ADA.
The proposal states independent audits and assurance will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.
Intersect discloses that Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA from listed Cardano Treasury withdrawal governance actions within the past 24 months.

The proposal states treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role thresholds, an external Oversight Committee, and references to smart contract documentation and audits.
The proposal states a public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for the community to audit and track metrics related to the withdrawn ADA, with activity also immutably verifiable on chain.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect's 2026-2027 operating, governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, and critical-process functions, with budget breakdowns, prior funding disclosure, NCL and Hydra-voting references, and smart-contract administration details.
